raw_html: [[Antimagic Spike|Antimagic Spike ]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Antimagic Spike|Antimagic Spike ]]:''' This item was made from powerful antimagic materials. When scoring a critical hit on an enemy with your ranged or melee weapons, the target must make a DC 28 [[Fortitude save]] or be unable to cast spells for a brief duration.
